answer: Deposits are visible in nadir, and pearl reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 166 aliases, and each one needs its own funded haven account. The attacker spends 300 dollars and 10 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
